The aircraft's wing is partially visible on the right, featuring a glowing green navigation light at the winglet. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a modern airplane cabin. A laptop is open on a tray table, displaying structured text and data spreadsheets. In front, a large seat-back entertainment screen plays an animated Japanese cartoon featuring characters in a city setting. (3) A comprehensive multi-course meal tray is shown on the tray table. A female hand with red nail polish picks up a dark brown, glossy bread roll from a small plate. The tray contains several bowls: a shrimp salad, a chicken appetizer, and a main dish with steak and gratin. (4) Close-up shots show the individual components of the meal. The shrimp salad features pink prawns and greens. The main dish is a thick steak covered in brown gravy, served with carrots, broccoli, and a golden-brown potato gratin. A white cup containing light yellow tea is lifted, showing steam. (5) The final phase highlights the dessert course. A plate contains fresh slices of green kiwi, yellow melon, purple grapes, and red apple. A small tub of Häagen-Dazs green tea ice cream is presented alongside a spoon. The cabin lighting is soft and warm, typical of a long-haul business class environment.
